content.short: Exaverse is a mobile-first, 8-bit style roguelike dungeon crawler featuring sentient dinosaurs.
content.description: Exaverse is a unique decentralized gaming experience that combines traditional roguelike mechanics with a sci-fi setting and digital ownership. Players control sentient dinosaurs known as Exadons in a fight against invading machine forces, exploring procedurally generated dungeons filled with challenges and rewards. Built for mobile platforms and utilizing Immutable-X for secure digital asset management, the game features turn-based strategic gameplay and deep character progression through a variety of unique abilities and items. Exaverse emphasizes player creativity and community engagement, creating a fun, interactive, and rewarding social ecosystem that redefines the boundaries of decentralized entertainment.
content.meta: Exaverse is a premier mobile-first roguelike dungeon crawler featuring digital dinosaur ownership and strategic Web3 gameplay for global players.

resources.tldr: The setup behind Extinction of the Exaverse: dinosaurs that survived and became intelligent, now facing machines overrunning their biomes.

resources.title: Could Dinosaurs Have Become Intelligent?
resources.tldr: A genuine detour into speculative evolution: what might have followed had the extinction event 66 million years ago never happened.
